_note: Store screenshot sizes: the ONE place to edit when a store changes its rules. Checked 2026-11-12 against Google's Play Console help page and several current third-party guides; Apple's own page could not be opened, so re-check https://developer.apple.com/help/app-store-connect/reference/screenshot-specifications before each release and edit this file if a size changed.

play.label: Google Play Console
play.uploadPath: Play Console > your app > Grow users > Store presence > Main store listing > Graphics
play.rule: each side 320-3840 px, long side at most 2x the short side

targets.label: Phone
targets.note: 2 to 8 screenshots. 1080x1920 (9:16) is the recommended size.

targets.label: 7-inch tablet
targets.note: Optional but recommended: improves the listing on tablets.

targets.label: 10-inch tablet
targets.note: Optional. Sources disagree on the exact size (1600x2560 or 1920x1200); this one satisfies Google's side and ratio rule.

graphics.label: Feature graphic
graphics.note: Required to publish. JPEG or 24-bit PNG, no transparency.

graphics.label: App icon
graphics.note: 32-bit PNG, up to 1024 KB, uploaded in the Console (the icon inside the app is separate).

appstore.label: Apple App Store Connect
appstore.uploadPath: App Store Connect > your app > the version > Previews and Screenshots
appstore.rule: exact pixel sizes only (a size that is not on the list is rejected)

targets.label: iPhone 6.9-inch
targets.note: Required for iPhone. Apple scales this set down to the smaller iPhone sizes.

targets.label: iPhone 6.5-inch
targets.note: Optional. Only needed if you do not upload the 6.9-inch set.

targets.label: iPad 13-inch
targets.required: if the app runs on iPad
targets.note: Required while app.config.ts has ios.supportsTablet: true. Apple scales it down to the smaller iPad sizes.

graphics.label: App icon (reference)
graphics.note: Apple takes the 1024x1024 icon from the app build (assets/icon.png), not from this upload. Made here only so you can compare.
